<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/certificate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists each CA of the trust store through gohai: the distribution's and the local ones on Linux, from the family's directories, and the system keychains on macOS, each with its subject, fingerprint and expiry. A CA that osapi deployed reads by the name that it was deployed with, not its file's osapi- name, and is managed.
